objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of Power BI
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world Power BI tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in Power BI
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with Power BI industry best practices

modules.title: Module 1: Data Ingestion & Power Query ETL (M Language)
modules.summary: Connect disparate raw sources, unpivot crosstab spreadsheets cleanly, enforce column schemas, and preserve database Query Folding.
lessonTitles: Power BI Workflow & Power Query Unpivoting (M Language)
Data Profiling, Quality Gates & Query Folding
modules.checkpoint: Transform dirty multi-column Excel reports into clean typed narrow tables.

modules.title: Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions
modules.summary: Design clean Star Schemas linking Fact transactions to Dimension lookups cleanly via single-direction 1-to-many relationships and contiguous Date tables.
lessonTitles: Fact vs Dimension Tables, Cardinality & Star Schema Design
modules.checkpoint: Resolve many-to-many / bi-directional ambiguity into a fast conformed Star Schema.

modules.title: Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting
modules.summary: Master Row Context vs Filter Context, `CALCULATE`, `VAR`, `SUMX` iterators, YoY Time Intelligence, and clean accessible dashboard UX.
lessonTitles: DAX Fundamentals: Row vs Filter Context, SUMX & CALCULATE
modules.checkpoint: Author resilient dynamic DAX metrics and build intuitive visual hierarchies.

practiceActivities: Unpivot messy wide monthly Excel budgets via Power Query M into clean Star Schema rows
Construct contiguous Date dimensions and 1-to-many Fact/Dimension relationships
Author Time Intelligence YoY/MTD metrics via CALCULATE, VAR, and DIVIDE
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Data Ingestion & Power Query ETL (M Language) Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Star Schema Modeling & Date Dimensions Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: DAX Analytics & Executive Reporting Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Executive Revenue & Retention Interactive Star-Schema Power BI Model + DAX Measure Catalog
proficiencyCriteria: Clean raw data upstream via foldable Power Query transformations
Design high-speed single-directional Star Schemas avoiding ambiguous bi-directional loops
Write bug-free DAX measures utilizing CALCULATE, context transition, and VAR cleanly
